title: What's new in v2.7.2
summary: See the current readings in Monitoring right next to min/max/mean, and the module inside your cellular modem.

steps.title: Monitoring stats tables
steps.listLabel: See the current reading for device / modem stats
steps.body: Every stats table in Monitoring now has the **Latest** value shown for every stat. The **Latest** column is tinted to break up the columns in the stats table for easier scanning.

steps.title: Modem module and firmware
steps.listLabel: See the module inside your cellular modem and what firmware it runs
steps.body: The **Cellular Stats (5G / LTE)** card now shows the **Module** inside your modem, with its firmware on hover. Hover the device name and icon above it for the modem or router's own firmware.
